1.consolidated_definition: Una argolla de hierro que se remachaba alrededor del tobillo del esclavo castigado, con una cadena que se aseguraba a un poste o a una pared, o a un mono.
1.en_consolidated_definition: An iron cuff that was riveted around the ankle of a punished slave, with a chain secured to a post or wall, or to a monkey.
